models.notes: Unitree G1 page (columns G1 and G1 EDU; base G1 values used). Reach is doubtful: Unitree publishes only 'Arm Span: About 0.45M' (approximate, not described as a reach), recorded here as per-arm reach. Arm payload is per arm: about 2 kg (G1) or about 3 kg (G1 EDU); Unitree notes it 'varies greatly under different arm extension postures'. DoF: 23 total for the G1 ('23 - 43' for the G1 EDU), 5 per arm. Footprint is the standing width x thickness (450 x 200 mm); standing height 1320 mm. Mass about 35 kg ('About 35kg+' for EDU). Walking speed: no Unitree page publishes one; 2 m/s is from the Elektor reseller listing ('Moving speed of 2 m/s'), not attributed to Unitree there. Recipe: none; the asset catalog's unitree_g1_dex3_v1 is the 29-DoF body with hands, not the base 23-DoF G1 these figures describe.

models.notes: Stretch 3 has been superseded by Stretch 4 (hello-robot.com now shows Stretch 4 only). Figures come from Hello Robot's archived Stretch 3 docs on docs-arch.hello-robot.com: the 'Stretch 3 - Datasheet' image (Revision 2.14.2024) and the Stretch 3 hardware guide. Reach 0.52 m is the telescoping arm's reach ('Reach: 0.52m'); the guide also says 'Recommended Max payload - 2kg'. Size 33 x 34 x 141 cm is the overall L x W x H; the guide says the retracted arm and wrist fit within the base footprint. The datasheet does not say which of 33 cm and 34 cm is the length. The guide lists base, lift, telescoping arm, a 3-DoF wrist (yaw, pitch, roll), gripper and 2-DoF head but gives no total.
